speaker: Alicia
original_jp: まだどこか痛むのですか？

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: こんな事を言うのは失礼ですが <PART> ――
original_en:
I hope that you won't take this the
wrong way,

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: あんたのほうが よっぱど大変だろ…
original_en: Ha, you've got it so much worse than I do.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: もし私が〓ている間にシルメリアが召喚されたら <PART> ――
original_en:
I wondered what would happen if she were
summoned while I slept at night.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 私は二度と目覚める事がないまま消えると思うと 〓れませんでした
original_en:
Would I never wake up? Would I just
disappear? I couldn't sleep.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 魂が消えるって…どんな感じでしょうか？
original_en:
How would it feel if your soul faded
away?

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: あんたは達〓したのかもしれないけど俺は今でも〓るのが怖いぜ…
original_en:
Maybe you got over it, but I'm still
afraid to close my eyes at night.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 神は私達に安らぎを与えてはくれないのですね…
original_en:
I don't think the gods will ever grant
us peace.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: もうよそうぜ こんな話…
original_en: Let's just give it a rest, okay?

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: とっととオーブ見つけて オーディンに一〓吹かせてやろうじゃねえの！
original_en:
We've gotta find that orb and give Odin
a taste of his own medicine!

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: …この世界で神に〓弄されているのは私だけだと思っていました
original_en:
I thought I was the only one. The only one
in the world tormented by the gods.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: シルメリアの事がわかり始めた頃〓 〓るのがとても怖かった…
original_en:
When I first realized Silmeria was with
me, I was afraid to fall asleep.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: あなたの話を聞いて 正直少しだけ楽になりました
original_en:
but, hearing what you said made me feel
a lot better.
